title: Move the reviewer input-admission logic out of delegations.rs
outcome: The launch admission, follow-up re-admission and re-arm admission selection for read-only reviewers live in delegation_review_input.rs behind small helpers called from delegations.rs, which shrinks rather than grows; behaviour unchanged.
acceptance: delegations.rs calls helpers from delegation_review_input.rs for launch admission, follow-up re-admission and re-arm admission installation; the move is a pure code move with the review-input test suite unchanged and green.
